lab_questions.title: Process Emergency Logistics Orders
lab_questions.description:
A medical logistics dispatcher prioritizes incoming delivery orders based on priority urgency scores (higher integer = higher priority). Orders with higher priority must be dispatched before lower priority orders. If two orders have identical priority scores, the order submitted earlier (lower order index) must be dispatched first.

Your task is to read the total number of orders N, followed by N integer priority scores, and print the order indices (0-indexed) in the exact sequence they will be dispatched.

tasks.title: Test Case 1
tasks.description:
Validate your code against test case 1.
Input:
5
30 50 10 50 20
Expected Output: 1 3 0 4 2

solution.python:
import sys
data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.read().split()))
if data:
    n = data[0]
    priorities = data[1:n+1]
    indexed = [(priorities[i], -i, i) for i in range(n)]
    indexed.sort(key=lambda x: (x[0], x[1]), reverse=True)
    print(' '.join(str(item[2]) for item in indexed))
